Full original isospectrality is equivalent to equality of the actual normalized physical Hill discriminants as functions on ALL complex energies. Equality includes the normalization and sign, not just the characteristic zero set.

Real scalar diagonal source insertion is a closed embedding. Its preimage of an ACTUAL real Hilbert Dirac isospectral set is compact in the scalar L2 topology. The literal shifted rough Miura image is therefore compact in the entire unit-period H-minus-one norm.

Reality, mean zero and physical period one form a norm-closed locus in every original period-two Fourier-Lebesgue space at every real order and every Banach exponent, including infinity. The entire physical distribution and exact Fourier convention are retained.

The entire original potential domain explicitly carries the topology induced by the unchanged original H-minus-one norm. In this topology the full original isospectral set is closed, and the source-domain inclusion is a closed embedding.

The ENTIRE original real mean-zero physical period-one H-minus-one isospectral set is compact in the unchanged original H-minus-one norm, with NO endpoint regularity premise.
